source_evidence: Exact player 'Let’s do that' accepts social call. Existing legitimate interests and courteous routine introduction provide plausible willing access, not a contested concession or guaranteed hidden evidence. D327~10:15 at House Veldrake townhouse reception room, Old Crown Ward, Orsaven. Exact player 'Let’s do that' accepts Mara's immediately preceding suggestion of a legitimate social visit to House Veldrake, not exposure of evidence, accusations, covert search, deception check, spending or trade commitment. Ordinary public approach and routine introductions; V returns to ordinary presentation instead of wearing yesterday's temporary worker apron/cap, both remain in his belongings, no additional item acquisition or disposal. Household attendant conveys visitor introduction; Lady Halvessa Veldrake, senior patron, is actually available and elects to receive the visiting landed house for a brief social/business introduction. Newly played townhouse reception setting (tall windows, ancestral portraits, tapestries and visible fine ivory lace trim); ordinary visual detail, lace provenance unproven, no identification as specific smuggled lot. V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar present; horses/coach at Copper Hart. Mara introduces party and their actual river-holding commercial interests, no negotiated deal or private investigation disclosed. Halvessa cordial, observant, status-conscious and interested in potential trade contacts; she knows party's names and actual legitimate commercial interests from introduction, not secret ancestry, their Watch evidence, unauthorized search or Quenwood investigation. She asks what brings House Vaishnavi to her door, and whether they seek new trade connections or introductions, without confessing or volunteering hidden arrangements. Jorveth Sallow not present in this audience; no automatic agent access, patron supper, broker/Tavosk appearance or actual investment. Existing fixed truth and scope retained in prep/dm-only/dm-ferry-setup.md @72d5bde0ab9d84d89fdc63f20cf9c7bfb63b1516, world/politics/human-states.md @77333e27aa5946858c824352e71af893aa6e1b96. New social opening and availability are first-play adjudication, not historical schedule or guarantee of further concessions. V knows public Tavosk petition, House Veldrake senior patron and agent Sallow, matching agent mark but no proven personal authorization; no suspect previously confronted. Desen holds two original exhibits (36gp Lot27 invoice, sealed 14gp acknowledgement identified as Tavosk) and copy of V's notes; Cirren holds signed evidence receipt and V retains own notes on D321 L-9 instruction, D322 24gp receipt and matching Veldrake account. No lawful corroboration, warrant, arrest, restitution or new notification verified. Paymaster recorded48gp held. Quenwood life sentence upheld/assets frozen, no proof other actors participated in murders. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi4/6 MP7/7 PastLife2/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers0/1 inactive cloak+Luckstone; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots +1Shield no concentration; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40 breastplate/Insignia natural+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging mechanical greataxe unchanged. Mara/animals healthy. Purse2047gp8sp6cp rations21/feed28 LR2/6, no spend/rest/roll. Meret referral delivered no contract; Ossent royal recommendation pending actual decision, Kestrel copies confidential originals retained; Crown frontier300+1300 contingent; western conditional grant signed not deed, Coris300 pending optional800 field; magic balance520 target353; Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed. V dice delegated. Await V's own response to Halvessa.
